# Subset Macro
```{r subset_Macro}
seurat.combined.sct <- readRDS("./3_Integration/data/2024-05-10/seurat_combined_sct_umap_renamed.rds")
seurat.combined.sct <- NormalizeData(seurat.combined.sct, assay = "RNA")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct) <- "renamed_cluster"
Macro.cells <- subset(seurat.combined.sct, idents = c("Macrophage"))
saveRDS(Macro.cells,file.path(data_dir,paste0("Macro.cells.rds")))

# split condition
split_seurat <- SplitObject(Macro.cells, split.by = "sample")
split_seurat <- split_seurat[c("Chow","HFSC")]

seurat.list <- lapply(X = split_seurat, FUN = SCTransform, verbose = FALSE)
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = seurat.list , nfeatures = 3000)
seurat.list <- PrepSCTIntegration(object.list = seurat.list, anchor.features = features)
seurat.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = seurat.list, normalization.method = "SCT",
                                         anchor.features = features)
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- IntegrateData(anchorset = seurat.anchors, normalization.method = "SCT")
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- RunPCA(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, verbose = FALSE)

# ElbowPlot
png(filename = './subset_Macro/Macro_ElbowPlot.png')
ElbowPlot(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, ndim = 30)
dev.off()

ndims <- 20
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- RunUMAP(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, reduction = "pca", dims = 1:ndims)
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- FindNeighbors(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, dims = 1:ndims, verbose = FALSE)
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- FindClusters(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, verbose = FALSE, resolution = seq(0.1,1,0.1))
for(res in seq(0.1,1,0.1)){
  cat("#### res:",res, "\n")
  Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- paste0("integrated_snn_res.", res)
  png(filename = sprintf('./subset_Macro/res_new_%s.png', res))
  p2 <- DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, label = T)
  print(p2)
  dev.off()
  cat("\n")
  cat("\n")
}

seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- FindClusters(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, verbose = FALSE, resolution = 0.2)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <-  "integrated_snn_res.0.3"
png(filename = './subset_Macro/res_0.3.png')
DimPlot(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, label = T)
seurat.combined.sct.Macro[[]] %>% head()
table(Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro))

metadata = seurat.combined.sct.Macro@meta.data 
png(filename = './subset_Macro/cell_counts_newcutoff.png')
metadata %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=sample, fill=sample)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  ggtitle("NCells")
dev.off()

markers.to.plot = c("Spp1","Trem2","Lpl","Cd9") # LAM
markers.to.plot = c("Mrc1","Lyve1","Cd163","Mtss1") # PVM
markers.to.plot = c("Prg4","Tgfb2","Ltbp1","Rp1") # RM
markers.to.plot = c("Pola1","Kif11","Kif15","Cdca2") #PLAM
markers.to.plot = c("Col5a2","Tgfbr3","Col3a1") #CEM
markers.to.plot = c("Cd74","Fcrls","Ear2","Cd163") #NPVM (BAM,Border-associated macrophages)
markers.to.plot = c("Col5a2","Tgfbr3","Col3a1") #AM
markers.to.plot = c("Ptprc","Itgam","Csf1r","Fcgr1a","Adgre1","Mertk","Hla-Dra","Cx3cr1") # or NPVM (BAM,Border-associated macrophages)


for(gene in markers.to.plot){
  if(gene %in% rownames(seurat.combined.sct.Macro)){
    cat("### ",gene, "\n")
    png(filename = sprintf('./subset_Macro/markers/markers_allsimple_%s.png', gene), width=6, height=6, units="in", res=100)
    p <- FeaturePlot(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, 
                     features = gene, reduction = "umap",
                     order = TRUE,
                     label = TRUE,
                     min.cutoff = "q10")
    #split.by = "orig.ident")
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    cat("\n")
  }
  else{
    cat("### ",gene, " \n")
    cat("Not present in dataset \n")
  }
  cat("\n")
}

saveRDS(seurat.combined.sct.Macro, file = file.path(data_dir, "seurat_combined_sct_umap_Macro.rds"))
```

## Clustering and annotation
```{r Macro_annotation}
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- readRDS("./subset_Macro/data/2024-05-06/seurat_combined_sct_umap_Macro.rds")
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <-  "integrated_snn_res.0.3"
table(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$integrated_snn_res.0.3)
assignment_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = c("0", "6",
              "3","4",
              "1",
              "8",
              "5","10",
              "7",
              "2",
              "9"), 
  sub_cluster = c(
    rep("NPVM",2), 
    rep("PVM",2),
    rep("LAM",1),
    rep("PLAM",1),
    rep("CEM1",2), 
    rep("CEM2",1),
    rep("AM", 1),
    rep("RM", 1)
  )
)

print(assignment_df)

assignment_df$sub_cluster = as.character(assignment_df$sub_cluster)

temp_meta <- seurat.combined.sct.Macro@meta.data %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "barcode") %>% 
  left_join(assignment_df, by = c("integrated_snn_res.0.3" = "cluster")) %>% 
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "barcode")

temp_meta <- temp_meta[,-32]
colnames(temp_meta)[34] <- "sub_cluster"
colnames(temp_meta)

temp_meta$sub_cluster <- fct_explicit_na(temp_meta$renamed_cluster, "Unknown")
seurat.combined.sct.Macro$sub_cluster <- temp_meta[rownames(seurat.combined.sct.Macro@meta.data),"sub_cluster"]
table(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$sub_cluster)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- "sub_cluster"
levels(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- c("NPVM","LAM","PVM","AM","CEM1","CEM2","PLAM","RM")

#seurat.combined.sct.Macro$seurat_clusters <- as.factor(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$seurat_clusters)

seurat.combined.sct.Macro$DE_subgroup <- paste0(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$sub_cluster, "-", seurat.combined.sct.Macro$sample_simple)
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- "DE_subgroup"

as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$DE_subgroup)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(group = Var1, number_of_cells = Freq) %>% 
  DT::datatable()


Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- "sub_cluster"
levels(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- c("NPVM","LAM","PVM","AM","CEM1","CEM2","PLAM","RM")
```

## Statistical stacked pieplot (number & percent)

```{r cell_number_plot}
data_table <- as.data.frame(table(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$DE_subgroup))
data_table$groups <- rep(c("Chow","HFSC"),8)
colnames(data_table) = c("Cell Types","Numbers","Groups")
data_table <- data_table %>%
  mutate(`Cell Types` = sub("-.*", "", `Cell Types`))
df_wide <- data_table %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Groups, values_from = Numbers)
df_wide$`Cell Types` <- factor(df_wide$`Cell Types`, levels = c("NPVM", "PVM", "LAM", "AM", "CEM1", "CEM2", "PLAM", "RM"))
df_wide <- df_wide %>% 
  arrange(`Cell Types`)
write.csv(df_wide,"./subset_Macro/Macro subcluster cell number.csv", row.names = F,quote = F)

  angle = c(26.26609442,21.20952009,1.299258681,3.651970347,1.439719079,1.299258681,2.212251268,0.561841592,2.77409286,8.743659774,10.60476005,17.48731955,15.66133437,24.58056964,14.85368709,27.3546625)# 角度
)
data$category <- factor(data$category, levels = c("NPVM-Chow","PVM-Chow","LAM-Chow","AM-Chow","CEM1-Chow","CEM2-Chow","PLAM-Chow","RM-Chow","RM-HFSC","PLAM-HFSC","CEM2-HFSC","CEM1-HFSC","AM-HFSC","LAM-HFSC","PVM-HFSC","NPVM-HFSC"))
```

### Barplot2 hfsc vs chow
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)

# ----- Palette (hue = Macro subcluster; shade = diet/group) -----
base_cols <- c(
  NPVM = "#7876B1",
  PVM  = "#FFDC90",
  LAM  = "#1F864E",
  AM   = "#BC3B29",
  CEM1 = "#0171B5",
  CEM2 = "#E18728",
  PLAM = "#6F99AD",
  RM   = "#EE4B97"
)

fill_map <- c(
  setNames(base_cols,              paste0(names(base_cols), ".Chow")),
  setNames(alpha(base_cols, 0.45), paste0(names(base_cols), ".HFSC"))
)

# ----- Build count table from metadata (robust) -----
meta <- seurat.combined.sct.Macro@meta.data
ct_levels <- rev(c("NPVM","PVM","LAM","AM","CEM1","CEM2","PLAM","RM"))

df <- meta %>%
  count(`Cell Types` = sub_cluster, Groups = sample_simple, name = "Numbers") %>%
  filter(Groups %in% c("Chow","HFSC")) %>%
  mutate(
    `Cell Types` = factor(`Cell Types`, levels = ct_levels),
    Groups = factor(Groups, levels = c("Chow","HFSC")),
    fill_id = interaction(`Cell Types`, Groups, sep = ".")
  )

# ----- Left panel: absolute counts (Chow above HFSC) -----
C2 <- ggplot(df, aes(y = `Cell Types`, x = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE)) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Numbers),
    position = position_dodge2(width = 0.75, reverse = TRUE),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 2.2, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 5, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 5)
  ) +
  xlab("Numbers") +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

# ----- Right panel data: within-group proportions -----
dfp <- df %>%
  group_by(Groups) %>%
  mutate(pct = Numbers / sum(Numbers)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Flip stack order (keep consistent with your EC/ASPC style)
stack_order <- rev(levels(df$`Cell Types`))

dfp <- dfp %>%
  mutate(
    fill_id = factor(
      as.character(fill_id),
      levels = c(paste0(stack_order, ".Chow"),
                 paste0(stack_order, ".HFSC"))
    )
  )
stopifnot(sum(is.na(dfp$fill_id)) == 0)

# ----- Right panel: stacked proportions (0–1 axis) + label >= 3% -----
D2 <- ggplot(dfp, aes(x = Groups, y = Numbers, fill = fill_id)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill", width = 0.8) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(pct >= 0.03, percent(pct, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
    position = position_fill(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 1.8, colour = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, na.value = "grey80") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
    labels = number_format(accuracy = 0.01),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 6) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7, colour = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.3)
  ) +
  xlab("Groups")

# ----- Combine & export -----
combined_plot <- C2 + D2 +
  plot_layout(widths = c(2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    "Number & Percent \nof Macrophage Subclusters",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8))
  )
getwd()
ggsave("./subset_Macro/cellnumber_info222.pdf", combined_plot, width = 2.7, height = 3)
```

```{r trajectory}
#umap降维

cds <- learn_graph(cds)
```

# Macro subcluster loop：DE + Volcano + Bubble
```{r Macro_DE_volcano_bubble_loop}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)

# -----------------------------
# Input object settings
# -----------------------------
DefaultAssay(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- "RNA"
Idents(seurat.combined.sct.Macro) <- "DE_subgroup"
table(seurat.combined.sct.Macro$DE_subgroup)

# Merge layers once
seurat.combined.sct.Macro <- JoinLayers(seurat.combined.sct.Macro)

# Subclusters (use your provided levels)
macro_types <- c("NPVM","LAM","PVM","AM","CEM1","CEM2","PLAM","RM")

# Output folders
date_dir <- "2024-05-06"
data_dir <- file.path("./subset_Macro/data",    date_dir)
res_dir  <- file.path("./subset_Macro/results", date_dir)
plot_dir <- file.path("./subset_Macro/plots",   date_dir)

if (!dir.exists(data_dir)) dir.create(data_dir, recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(res_dir))  dir.create(res_dir,  recursive = TRUE)
if (!dir.exists(plot_dir)) dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE)

# -----------------------------
# Thresholds (match your Macro DE export)
# -----------------------------
sig_adjP <- 0.01

# Volcano thresholds (same scheme as before)
logFCcut  <- 1
pvalCut   <- 1e-2
logFCcut2 <- 2
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2  <- 1e-10
pvalCut3  <- 1e-20

# Axis control
x_buffer <- 0.5
robust_x_q <- 0.99      # robust symmetric xlim for volcano
robust_y_q <- 0.99      # robust ymax for volcano (tight and scientific)
min_xlim <- logFCcut2   # ensure at least covers ±2

# -----------------------------
# Helpers: robust symmetric xlim
# -----------------------------
robust_symmetric_xlim <- function(logfc, q = 0.99, buffer = 0.5, min_limit = 2) {
  logfc <- logfc[is.finite(logfc)]
  if (length(logfc) == 0) return(c(-min_limit, min_limit))
  abs_fc <- abs(logfc)

  qv <- as.numeric(stats::quantile(abs_fc, probs = q, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE))
  if (!is.finite(qv) || length(abs_fc) < 50) qv <- max(abs_fc, na.rm = TRUE)

  lim <- max(qv, min_limit, na.rm = TRUE)
  lim <- ceiling(lim + buffer)
  c(-lim, lim)
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: Volcano plot
# -----------------------------
make_volcano <- function(x, title_text = "") {

  # X-axis: symmetric, include ALL points
  logfc <- x$logFC[is.finite(x$logFC)]
  xmax_abs <- max(abs(logfc), na.rm = TRUE)
  xmax_abs <- ceiling(xmax_abs + x_buffer)

  # Y-axis: include ALL points
  logp <- -log10(x$P.Value)
  logp <- logp[is.finite(logp)]
  ymax <- max(logp, na.rm = TRUE)
  ymax <- ceiling(ymax * 1.05)

  ymin <- 0

  # Color mapping
  n1 <- nrow(x)
  cols <- rep("grey", n1)
  names(cols) <- rownames(x)

  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- "#f77e7e"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- "#c21b2b"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- "#73b6f5"
  cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- "#136cbf"

  x$color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)

  # Size mapping
  size <- rep(1, n1)
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC >  logFCcut]  <- 2
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2] <- 4
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC >  logFCcut3] <- 6
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut  & x$logFC < -logFCcut]  <- 2
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2] <- 4
  size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3] <- 6

  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value))) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +
    labs(
      x = bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"),
      y = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
      title = title_text
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40",
               linetype="longdash", lwd=0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40",
               linetype="longdash", lwd=0.1) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40",
               linetype="longdash", lwd=0.1) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40",
               linetype="longdash", lwd=0.1) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(-xmax_abs, xmax_abs),
      ylim = c(ymin, ymax)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  # Labels
  n_label <- 2
  p <- p +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = ifelse(logFC >  n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 5, Gene, "")),
      colour="#9c0917", size=3,
      box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
    ) +
    geom_text_repel(
      aes(label = ifelse(logFC < -n_label & -log10(P.Value) > 5, Gene, "")),
      colour="#0054a3", size=3,
      box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
      point.padding = unit(0.01, "lines")
    )

  return(p)
}

# -----------------------------
# Helper: Bubble plot
# (sig set first, then rank by LogFC, take extremes)
# -----------------------------
make_bubble <- function(x_sig, title_text = "") {

  if (nrow(x_sig) < 2) return(NULL)

  # Sort by LogFC and take extremes (Areg logic)
  data <- x_sig[order(x_sig$LogFC, decreasing = FALSE), , drop = FALSE]

  n_half <- min(20, floor(nrow(data) / 2))
  if (n_half < 1) return(NULL)

  data <- rbind(
    data[1:n_half, , drop = FALSE],
    data[(nrow(data) - n_half + 1):nrow(data), , drop = FALSE]
  )

  data$ID <- factor(data$ID, levels = unique(data$ID))
  data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$LogFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                            levels = c("Up", "Down"))

  xmax_abs <- max(abs(data$LogFC), na.rm = TRUE)
  xmax_abs <- ceiling(xmax_abs + 0.5)

  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x=LogFC, y=ID, size=-log10(P.value),
                        shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
    geom_point(stroke = 1) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill="white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey", size=0.1),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size=8, face="bold"),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size=10, color="black", face="bold"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size=14, face="bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size=14, face="bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      size  = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")),
      x = "LogFC",
      y = "Gene Symbol",
      color = "Gene Regulation",
      shape = "Gene Regulation"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-xmax_abs, xmax_abs)) +
    guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

  return(p)
}

# Select a relaxed significant set for bubble plot if too few genes pass the cutoff
select_sig_for_bubble <- function(de2,
                                  cutoffs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2),
                                  n_target_each = 20) {

  # de2 columns: ID, P.value, LogFC, adjP.Value
  for (c in cutoffs) {
    x_sig <- de2[de2$adjP.Value <= c, , drop = FALSE]
    n_up <- sum(x_sig$LogFC > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    n_dn <- sum(x_sig$LogFC < 0, na.rm = TRUE)

    # Enough genes on both sides
    if (n_up >= n_target_each && n_dn >= n_target_each) {
      return(list(data = x_sig, cutoff_used = c))
    }
  }

  # If still insufficient, return the least strict sig set
  # If even that is tiny, fall back to all genes to avoid empty plots
  x_sig <- de2[de2$adjP.Value <= max(cutoffs), , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(x_sig) < 2) x_sig <- de2

  return(list(data = x_sig, cutoff_used = max(cutoffs)))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main loop: DE + export + plots
# -----------------------------
for (ct in macro_types) {

  message("Processing ", ct)

  ident_hfsc <- paste0(ct, "-HFSC")
  ident_chow <- paste0(ct, "-Chow")

  markers <- FindMarkers(
    object  = seurat.combined.sct.Macro,
    ident.1 = ident_hfsc,
    ident.2 = ident_chow
  )

  markers_df <- markers %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "gene") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(p_val_adj)

  # Save RDS
  saveRDS(markers_df, file = file.path(data_dir, paste0("markers_", ct, ".rds")))

  # Export full CSV
  full_csv <- file.path(res_dir, paste0("DE_results_", ct, "-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv"))
  rio::export(markers_df, file = full_csv)

  # Export sig CSV (adjP <= 0.01, your Macro setting)
  markers_df_sig <- markers_df %>% dplyr::filter(p_val_adj <= sig_adjP)
  sig_csv <- file.path(res_dir, paste0("DE_results_", ct, "-HFSC_vs_Chow_sig01.csv"))
  rio::export(markers_df_sig, file = sig_csv)

  # --------
  # Volcano plot input table (standardize column names)
  # --------
  de <- read.csv(full_csv)
  colnames(de)[1:6] <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
  rownames(de) <- de$Gene

  # Volcano
  p_vol <- make_volcano(de, title_text = paste0(ct, ": HFSC vs Chow"))
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_volcano.pdf")), p_vol, width=6, height=6)
  ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_volcano.png")), p_vol, width=6, height=6, dpi=500)

  # --------
  # Bubble plot input table (from sig set first)
  # --------
  de2 <- de[, c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","adjP.Value")]
  colnames(de2) <- c("ID","P.value","LogFC","adjP.Value")

  sig_pick <- select_sig_for_bubble(de2,
                                    cutoffs = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2),
                                    n_target_each = 20
                                    )

  de2_sig <- sig_pick$data
  cutoff_used <- sig_pick$cutoff_used

  p_bub <- make_bubble(de2_sig, title_text = paste0("Significant DEGs in ", ct, ": HFSC vs Chow"))
  if (!is.null(p_bub)) {
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_bubble.pdf")), p_bub, width=5, height=7, dpi=600)
    ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0("DE_", ct, "_bubble.png")), p_bub, width=5, height=7, dpi=600)
  } else {
    message("  Bubble skipped (not enough significant genes).")
  }
}
```
